description: This walk visits Lough Egish in County Monaghan. The lake is located between Ballybay, Castleblayney and Carrickmacross in a lovely, peaceful rural area.There are pleasant country lanes on the eastern side of the lake where you could enjoy a quiet walk or cycle with views towards the lough.You can continue your walking in the area at the nearbyLough Mucknoin Castleblayney.
